import re
import sys

def inspect(path):
    print("=" * 60)
    print("FILE:", path)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    print("Size:", len(data))
    print("Header:", data[:16])
    print("Has /Encrypt:", b"/Encrypt" in data)
    print("Has /ObjStm:", b"/ObjStm" in data)
    print("Has /XRef stream marker:", b"/Type /XRef" in data or b"/Type/XRef" in data)
    print("Has XRefStm:", b"/XRefStm" in data)

    # startxref
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        print("No startxref found!")
        return None
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))
    print("startxref offset:", xref_pos)
    snippet = data[xref_pos:xref_pos + 120]
    print("xref snippet:", snippet[:120])

    # Check what's at xref_pos
    at = data[xref_pos:xref_pos + 8]
    if at.startswith(b"xref"):
        print("Xref type: classic table")
    else:
        print("Xref type: stream (or unexpected)")

    # Count classic indirect objects
    objs = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\b", data)
    print("Classic 'N G obj' definitions found:", len(objs))
    if objs:
        print("First few:", objs[:10])
        nums = [int(a) for a, _ in objs]
        print("Min obj num:", min(nums), "Max:", max(nums))
    return data

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for p in sys.argv[1:]:
        inspect(p)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate combined_report.pdf: xref integrity, object parseability, page tree."""

import re
import sys

REF_RE = re.compile(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R(?![A-Za-z0-9])")
OBJ_HEAD_RE = re.compile(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\b")

def parse_object_at(data, offset):
    m = OBJ_HEAD_RE.match(data, offset)
    if not m:
        return None
    objnum, gen = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
    i = offset + m.end()
    e = data.find(b"endobj", i)
    s = data.find(b"stream", i)
    if s != -1 and s < e:
        dict_bytes = data[i:s]
        ss = s + len(b"stream")
        if data[ss:ss + 2] == b"\r\n":
            ss += 2
        elif data[ss:ss + 1] in (b"\n", b"\r"):
            ss += 1
        es = data.find(b"endstream", ss)
        e2 = data.find(b"endobj", es)
        end = e2 + len(b"endobj")
        return objnum, gen, dict_bytes, end
    dict_bytes = data[i:e]
    return objnum, gen, dict_bytes, e + len(b"endobj")


def main(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    xref_pos = int(m.group(1))
    assert data[xref_pos:xref_pos + 4] == b"xref", "not a classic xref"

    mm = re.search(rb"xref\s+(.*?)\s+trailer\s*(<<.*?>>)", data[xref_pos:], re.S)
    body, trailer = mm.group(1), mm.group(2)
    entries = {}
    start = None
    for line in body.splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit():
            start, count = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])
            continue
        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0].isdigit():
            off, gen, typ = int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), parts[2]
            if typ == b"n":
                entries[(start, gen)] = off
                start += 1
    print("xref entries:", len(entries))

    objects = {}
    for (num, gen), off in entries.items():
        parsed = parse_object_at(data, off)
        assert parsed is not None, "object %d unparseable" % num
        onum, ogen, d, _ = parsed
        assert (onum, ogen) == (num, gen), "object %d header mismatch" % num
        objects[(num, gen)] = d
    print("parsed objects:", len(objects))

    cm = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", trailer)
    root = (int(cm.group(1)), int(cm.group(2)))
    print("catalog object:", root)
    cat = objects[root]

    pm = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", cat)
    pages_root = (int(pm.group(1)), int(pm.group(2)))
    print("pages root object:", pages_root)

    leaves = []
    stack = [pages_root]
    while stack:
        ref = stack.pop()
        d = objects[ref]
        typ = re.search(rb"/Type\s*/(\w+)", d)
        typ = typ.group(1) if typ else None
        km = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", d, re.S)
        kids = km.group(1) if km else None
        if typ == b"Pages" and kids is not None:
            for r in REF_RE.findall(kids):
                stack.append((int(r[0]), int(r[1])))
        else:
            leaves.append(ref)
    print("leaf pages:", len(leaves))

    # Every leaf page must point at the new root pages node.
    bad_parents = 0
    for ref in leaves:
        d = objects[ref]
        p = re.search(rb"/Parent\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+R", d)
        if p is None or (int(p.group(1)), int(p.group(2))) != pages_root:
            bad_parents += 1
    print("leaf pages with wrong /Parent:", bad_parents)

    # Every /Pages /Kids ref must resolve to an existing object.
    unresolved = 0
    for (num, gen), d in objects.items():
        for r in REF_RE.findall(d):
            if (int(r[0]), int(r[1])) not in objects:
                unresolved += 1
    print("unresolved references in dicts:", unresolved)

    ok = (bad_parents == 0 and unresolved == 0 and len(leaves) >= 2)
    print("VALIDATION:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "combined_report.pdf")
